subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures expose clearer user-facing diagnostics through metadata/UI only, or should the direct `/avatar/{agentId}` endpoint itself return more specific failure statuses such as 413 or 400?
rationale: The remaining behavior sits on an authenticated local workspace file-serving route, so clearer feedback improves UX but can change information-disclosure boundaries and the public route contract.

options.title: Improve UI diagnostics only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches conservative while using existing `avatarStatus` and `avatarReason` metadata plus Control UI surfaces to show safe oversized or missing-file guidance.

options.title: Expose endpoint-specific errors
options.body: Return specific direct-route statuses such as 413 or 400 only with tests proving no unsafe path or policy details leak.

options.title: Fold into broader avatar policy
options.body: Defer this local diagnostics choice into the broader remote/local avatar contract tracked by issue #41201.

recommendation.title: Improve UI diagnostics only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches conservative while using existing `avatarStatus` and `avatarReason` metadata plus Control UI surfaces to show safe oversized or missing-file guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across avatar support, local avatar policy, and gateway avatar route hardening.
